name: rovexo/cbx-worktree-sites
description: Per-worktree dev sites on one shared container stack, published on real HTTPS subdomains behind a single wildcard certificate.

scripts.post-install-cmd: echo 'cbx-worktree-sites: run `vendor/bin/cbx-public-host status` — it names anything still missing.'

cbx-worktree-sites.note: Everything project-specific lives in that file at the consuming project's root. The package itself contains no project names, zones or ports.
